# Name notification CSS roles and illustration variants within their own families

The notification template uses kebab-case CSS classes such as in-app-notification-description, while its stylesheet uses dashed custom properties such as --close-button-text and --illustration-dark. Illustration filenames include the feature, purpose and variant: in-app-notification-donation-default-dark.svg. The matching jar.inc.mn entries and CSS URLs retain the exact filename. Follow these scoped namespaces when adding a role or variant. Shared notes separately cover dashed element modules, PascalCase classes and lowerCamelCase template IDs. The legacy stylesheet and include retain inAppNotificationContainer.css and inAppNotificationTemplates.inc.xhtml; these mixed artifact families do not justify a repository-wide rename.

Scope: Notification CSS and illustration naming.
